# Synthetic Office fixtures

These are actual OOXML packages generated by python-docx 1.2.0, openpyxl 3.1.5 and python-pptx 1.0.2. They contain only public synthetic text and the documentation IP 192.0.2.42. No private files or model responses are included.

Regenerate using `python3 scripts/generate-office-fixtures.py` from the repository root with those packages installed. ZIP timestamps and document core timestamps are fixed. A repeat generation was checked byte-for-byte; regeneration with different library versions may change package scaffolding.

- `migration.docx`: Chinese/Latin text split across formatted runs, a table, header, and an 830,849-byte uncompressed package. This checks that the 256 KiB plain-text source restriction is not incorrectly applied to Office containers. Extracted text is short.
- `invoice.xlsx`: sheet name, inline strings, numeric amount and a formula without a stored result. The parser must label cached formula values and never calculate formulas.
- `permissions.pptx`: two slides and presenter notes. Reading order follows presentation relationships, not ZIP entry order.

Unit tests also construct adversarial package fragments and shared-string workbooks; those exercise parser correctness and resource limits, not search quality. The real-model integration test uploads these files, runs the actual processor/Ollama, and queries the public hybrid endpoint. It is a pipeline smoke test, not the full labeled retrieval evaluation required by G04.
